facts.label: Draft storage

facts.label: Retention plan

facts.label: Analytics decision

answer.text: Keep drafts in this browser tab, with no account or hosted storage.

questions.prompt: How will people retain their notes?

answer.text: Offer a visible Save JSON button and remind people to save before closing.

questions.prompt: What should an exported notebook include?

answer.text: Include stable question IDs, parent links, recorded facts and review fingerprints.

questions.prompt: Should analytics ship in the first release?

answer.text: Proposal: leave analytics out until the team decides.
